strengths.text: The financial snapshot reports $1800000 ARR as contracted recurring platform revenue, which is separate from payment processing volume.
The financial snapshot reports 92% revenue growth year over year.

risks.text: BridgePay depends on licensed payment partners and third-party banks. Changes in partner access, compliance, fraud losses, or FX settlement could materially affect revenue. Shares are illiquid and may lose all value.
The founder update reports 20 months of runway. This is an unaudited founder figure, and corridor expansion remains only a plan.

diligenceQuestions: Which licensed partners and banks does BridgePay rely on, and what are the contract terms and termination rights?
